Nora (PM): Quick scope call  pilots demanding bulk embeddings in MVP; infra warns capacity dip next week. Need a plan.
Diego (Eng): What are the pilot SLOs?
Priya (CS): Two pilots: interactive p50<=220ms, nightly bulk up to 6-9M tokens. They can pay for reserved seats if we guarantee performance.
Amir (Infra): We're losing ~25% Dedicated capacity for maintenance window. Autoscale covers spikes but sustained nightly jobs will backlog.
Nora (PM): Options: (1) full include and reserve capacity (ops + billing), (2) drop bulk from public MVP and deliver later, (3) pilot-only opt-in carve. Thoughts?
Diego (Eng): I like (3): least disruption public-side. Implementation: org opt-in flag + routing to reserved pool. Fallback to quantized model if overload.
Jules (Design): UX: show "Pilot-only: bulk enabled" in org settings and hide public upload flows. Keep copy clear about limits.
Priya (CS): Pilots prefer opt-in carve. I'll try to secure a signed LOI for reserved slots; verbal OK for now.
Amir (Infra): For carve we can schedule nightly reserved window 01:30-05:30 UTC. Need ~36-48h to provision and test. We'll surface slot utilization metrics.
Diego (Eng): Work estimates: flag (0.5d), routing + tests (1.5d), canary (0.5d). Add smoke tests for nightly sim.
Nora (PM): Acceptance for pilot carve: - up to 8M tokens/night - interactive p50<=220ms - alerts at queue>55% - signed LOI before billing.
Priya (CS): I'll push LOI today; if not signed by EOD+3 we auto-disable pilot-only bulk and notify customers.
Diego (Eng): I'll add fallback policy: route to quantized-small model when reserved queue >70% and annotate responses with warning header.
Amir (Infra): Dashboard plan: reserved utilization, queue depth, token/sec, p50/p95. Alert rules at 50% and 80%.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: feat/pilot-embeds-carve -> staging at 2319998905
Nora (PM): OK — action owners: Diego (flag+fallback), Amir (provision+dash), Jules (UI copy), Priya (LOI). Reopen if legal or capacity changes. :thumbsup:
